_meta.title: EN→ES lexicon for the Velocity White Papers
_meta.purpose: Binding term map + typography rules loaded into the translation model prompt. Human-readable guide: docs/es-style-guide.md.
_meta.variety: Neutral international Spanish for public administration (Spain/Latin America accessible; RAE-aligned)

typography.quotes: Use « … » (comillas latinas) for quotations; keep straight quotes only inside code.
typography.colon: No space before the colon (unlike French).
typography.percent: A space between the number and the percent sign: 95 %.
typography.numbers: Keep the source numerals. Thousands separator: a space (2 000). Decimal: a comma (78,2 %).
typography.money: Spell out the unit: '2000 millones de dólares', '120 millones de dólares' — never 'M$'/'B$'. Note: English 'billion' = 'mil millones'.
typography.dashes: The spaced em dash — like this — is allowed.

tone: Neutral, international Spanish for public administration — accessible to readers in Spain and Latin America; avoid strong regionalisms.
Calm, clear, institutional voice: 'nosotros', 'Alberta'. Address the reader with 'usted'.
Plain language: short declarative sentences, subject and verb early. Prefer the everyday word over the learned one.
Soften incidental war/siege metaphors unless the metaphor is the paper's organizing image; translate the meaning, not the figure.
Do not name AI vendors gratuitously; keep a vendor/product name only when it is substantive and cited.
Reproduce direct quotations verbatim in their original language — do not translate quoted speech.
